rubric:
Unit: one active SP 800-53 Rev. 5 control or control enhancement (statement text). Hub entry: one active
CSF 2.0 subcategory (identifier and text). Rule on the set of required activities each describes, following
NIST IR 8477's set-theory relationship types:
  subset_of        every activity the unit requires is required by the subcategory, and the subcategory requires more
  superset_of      every activity the subcategory requires is required by the unit, and the unit requires more
  equal            the two require the same activities
  intersects_with  some required activities are shared, each side also requires activities the other does not
  no_relationship  no required activity is shared
Rule from the two texts alone. A packet shows source text, context, candidate and this rubric, never a proposal,
vote, confidence, route or prediction. When the texts do not settle the level, rule no_relationship and say why.
seed_basis: sha256 of the three pinned source hashes in sources.json, in file-name order

assisted_pairs.method: Python random.Random(seed).sample(ordered, count): without replacement, the standard library's sampler
assisted_pairs.ordering: eligible identities sorted as strings, ascending, before any draw
assisted_pairs.population: primary packets of the split that received a blind ruling, identified by packet id
assisted_pairs.rounding: count = int(round(share * population)) with Python's round (half to even); at least 1 when the population is non-empty
assisted_pairs.seed_derivation: sha256(protocol seed + ':' + draw name + ':' + split name), hex, as the Random seed

double_ruled.method: Python random.Random(seed).sample(ordered, count): without replacement, the standard library's sampler
double_ruled.ordering: eligible identities sorted as strings, ascending, before any draw
double_ruled.population: primary packets of the split, identified by their packet id
double_ruled.rounding: count = int(round(share * population)) with Python's round (half to even); at least 1 when the population is non-empty
double_ruled.seed_derivation: sha256(protocol seed + ':' + draw name + ':' + split name), hex, as the Random seed

missed_link.method: Python random.Random(seed).sample(ordered, count): without replacement, the standard library's sampler
missed_link.note: r = 5 for every unit; pool 98 when every top-k candidate is a distinct subcategory
missed_link.ordering: eligible identities sorted as strings, ascending, before any draw
missed_link.population: per unit: the hub entries outside the unit's retrieved top-k, identified by subcategory id
missed_link.rounding: count = int(round(share * population)) with Python's round (half to even); at least 1 when the population is non-empty
missed_link.seed_derivation: sha256(protocol seed + ':' + draw name + ':' + split name), hex, as the Random seed

ss_audit.method: Python random.Random(seed).sample(ordered, count): without replacement, the standard library's sampler
ss_audit.note: all of them when fewer exist; the pool size is recorded
ss_audit.ordering: eligible identities sorted as strings, ascending, before any draw
ss_audit.population: per card: outputs the card refused or flagged in the split, identified by output id
ss_audit.rounding: count = int(round(share * population)) with Python's round (half to even); at least 1 when the population is non-empty
ss_audit.seed_derivation: sha256(protocol seed + ':' + draw name + ':' + split name), hex, as the Random seed
